_comment: GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION is intentionally empty until a real Search Console token is provided -- no fake token. Read at build time by _build/analytics-head.js (via _build/gen.js) to decide whether to emit the GA4 tag / Search Console meta tag at all. Empty = not emitted, no console errors, no placeholder scripts. See ANALYTICS_IMPLEMENTATION.md for exactly how to fill these in and rebuild.
